label: Less than or equal to a day
definition: The provider's delivery contract lasts one day or less.

label: Day < x <= Week
definition: The provider's delivery contract lasts more than a day and up to a week.

label: Week < x <= Month
definition: The provider's delivery contract lasts more than a week and up to a month.

label: Month < x <= Year
definition: The provider's delivery contract lasts more than a month and up to a year.
